001package io.jstach.rainbowgum;
002
003import java.net.URI;
004import java.util.EnumSet;
005import java.util.Map;
006import java.util.Optional;
007import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
008
009import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty.Property;
010import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogPublisher.PublisherFactory;
011import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogPublisher.PublisherProvider;
012import io.jstach.rainbowgum.publisher.BlockingQueueAsyncLogPublisher;
013import io.jstach.rainbowgum.spi.RainbowGumServiceProvider;
014
015/**
016 * Registry of publishers. Rainbow Gum registers default publishers with the following
017 * schemes:
018 * <ul>
019 * <li>{@value #SYNC_SCHEME} - default sync publisher</li>
020 * <li>{@value #ASYNC_SCHEME} - default async publisher</li>
021 * <li>{@value #DEFAULT_SCHEME} - by default this is the same as
022 * {@link #SYNC_SCHEME}.</li>
023 * </ul>
024 * Plugins may override the above so that the above is automatically replaced with other
025 * providers via the service loader.
026 *
027 * @see RainbowGumServiceProvider
028 */
029public sealed interface LogPublisherRegistry extends LogPublisher.PublisherProvider {
030
031        /**
032         * Register a publisher provider by URI scheme.
033         * @param scheme uri scheme.
034         * @param publisherProvider provider.
035         */
036        public void register(String scheme, LogPublisher.PublisherProvider publisherProvider);
037
038        /**
039         * This is URI scheme for the async publisher used by the publisher builder. Call
040         * {@link #register(String, io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogPublisher.PublisherProvider)} with
041         * this scheme to replace the default async publisher.
042         */
043        public static String ASYNC_SCHEME = "async";
044
045        /**
046         * This is the URI scheme for the sync publisher builder to find a sync publisher.
047         * Call {@link #register(String, io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogPublisher.PublisherProvider)}
048         * with this scheme to replace the default sync publisher.
049         */
050        public static String SYNC_SCHEME = "sync";
051
052        /**
053         * This is the URI scheme for the default publisher.
054         * {@link #register(String, io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogPublisher.PublisherProvider)} with
055         * this scheme to replace the default publisher.
056         */
057        public static String DEFAULT_SCHEME = "default";
058
059        /**
060         * Because publisher configurators through service provider discovery can replace the
061         * default schemes of {@link #ASYNC_SCHEME}, {@link #SYNC_SCHEME} all the builtin core
062         * providers are prefixed with this value so that they can still be used even if
063         * overriden.
064         */
065        public static String BUILTIN_SCHEME_PREFIX = "core.";
066
067        /**
068         * Default async buffer size.
069         */
070        public static final int ASYNC_BUFFER_SIZE = 1024;
071
072        /**
073         * Buffer Size property name.
074         */
075        public static final String BUFFER_SIZE_NAME = "bufferSize";
076
077        /**
078         * Buffer Size Property for Async publishers.
079         */
080        public static final String BUFFER_SIZE_PROPERTY = LogProperties.PUBLISHER_PREFIX + BUFFER_SIZE_NAME;
081
082}
083
084final class DefaultPublisherRegistry implements LogPublisherRegistry {
085
086        private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, PublisherProvider> providers = new ConcurrentHashMap<String, LogPublisher.PublisherProvider>();
087
088        @Override
089        public PublisherFactory provide(LogProviderRef ref) {
090                ref = DefaultLogProviderRef.normalize(ref);
091                var uri = ref.uri();
092                String scheme = uri.getScheme();
093                if (scheme == null) {
094                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("URI is missing scheme. uri: " + uri);
095                }
096                var provider = Optional.ofNullable(providers.get(scheme)).orElseThrow();
097                return provider.provide(ref);
098        }
099
100        @Override
101        public void register(String scheme, LogPublisher.PublisherProvider publisherProvider) {
102                providers.put(scheme, publisherProvider);
103        }
104
105        /**
106         * Creates a publisher registry instance.
107         * @return publisher registry.
108         */
109        static LogPublisherRegistry of() {
110                var r = new DefaultPublisherRegistry();
111                for (var p : DefaultPublisherProviders.values()) {
112                        r.register(p.scheme(), p);
113                        r.register(BUILTIN_SCHEME_PREFIX + p.scheme(), p);
114                }
115                return r;
116        }
117
118}
119
120enum DefaultPublisherProviders implements LogPublisher.PublisherProvider {
121
122        DEFAULT {
123                @Override
124                public String scheme() {
125                        return LogPublisherRegistry.DEFAULT_SCHEME;
126                }
127
128                @Override
129                protected PublisherFactory provide(String name, LogProperties properties) {
130                        return (n, config, appenders) -> new DefaultSyncLogPublisher(appenders.asSingle());
131                }
132        },
133        SYNC {
134                @Override
135                public String scheme() {
136                        return LogPublisherRegistry.SYNC_SCHEME;
137                }
138
139                @Override
140                protected PublisherFactory provide(String name, LogProperties properties) {
141                        return (n, config, appenders) -> new DefaultSyncLogPublisher(appenders.asSingle());
142                }
143
144        },
145        ASYNC {
146
147                @Override
148                public String scheme() {
149                        return LogPublisherRegistry.ASYNC_SCHEME;
150                }
151
152                @Override
153                protected PublisherFactory provide(String name, LogProperties properties) {
154                        int _bufferSize = Property.builder()
155                                .ofInt() //
156                                .buildWithName(LogPublisherRegistry.BUFFER_SIZE_PROPERTY, name) //
157                                .get(properties) //
158                                .value(LogPublisherRegistry.ASYNC_BUFFER_SIZE);
159                        return (n, config, appenders) -> BlockingQueueAsyncLogPublisher
160                                .of(appenders.flags(EnumSet.of(LogAppender.AppenderFlag.REUSE_BUFFER)).asSingle(), _bufferSize);
161                }
162        };
163
164        @Override
165        public PublisherFactory provide(LogProviderRef ref) {
166                return (n, config, appenders) -> provide(ref.uri(), n, config.properties()).create(n, config, appenders);
167        }
168
169        public abstract String scheme();
170
171        protected abstract PublisherFactory provide(String name, LogProperties properties);
172
173        public PublisherFactory provide(URI uri, String name, LogProperties properties) {
174                String prefix = LogProperties.interpolateKey(LogProperties.PUBLISHER_PREFIX, Map.of(LogProperties.NAME, name));
175                LogProperties combined = LogProperties.of(uri, prefix, properties);
176                return provide(name, combined);
177        }
178
179}
